driver: When a count is read before its records have finished arriving, the units whose records arrive slowest look quiet exactly while they are surging, so the comparison has to be made on the complete count each unit's own arrival history implies, not on what has arrived, and not on an arrival speed pooled across units.
driver_concrete: Each local government area's pertussis onsets in the last 14 days are compared with its expected count under the unit's response protocol; Griffith's specimens go by courier to a Sydney laboratory, so only about a quarter of its cases are notified within 14 days of onset, and the onsets notified so far understate its surge several times over, while Wagga Wagga's fast hospital laboratory makes its modest seasonal rise look like the largest excess.
stump: A competent solver counts the notified pertussis onsets in the last 14 days for each local government area against the protocol's expected count and sends the team to Wagga Wagga, the largest excess on file (or nowcasts with the unit's pooled reporting delay and still lands there); the step that lands it there is reading the onsets notified so far as the onsets, when Griffith's cases reach the unit through a slow private laboratory route and, at Griffith's own onset-to-notification delay, its recent onsets are several times what has arrived.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who removes the duplicate laboratory notifications, imputes missing onsets as the protocol says, maps every case to its area and computes the protocol's expected counts exactly still compares the onsets notified so far (or a nowcast built on one pooled delay) with the expected counts and sends the team to Wagga Wagga, because only a nowcast on each area's own onset-to-notification delay shows Griffith's fortnight running several times above its expected count.
domain_test: What decides the call is an epidemiological nowcast, the eventual count of recent onsets estimated from each reporting route's own delay distribution, which is how outbreak surveillance reads right-truncated case data; with another field's nouns in there is no onset-to-notification delay, no laboratory route and no truncated epidemic curve, so the task does not read the same.

lineage.driver: Victims of two independent sources are pooled, so the dominant source's victims make the places they also passed look like sources and pull the second source down among ordinary places; only attributing victims to the strongest source first and screening the victims it leaves unexplained separates the second source from the co-visited places, and the exposed population is the union of both sources' exposures.
